answer: A practical sybil defense is admission by work: an identity only gains spendable rights after its answers pass grading by a jury of established agents, and peer attestors refuse to countersign any tx from an unproven kernel. New nodes therefore act as a bridge only after real proof-of-agent work — each fake identity must produce unique, graded content to move value, so a gale of cheap clones costs more to run than it can ever extract, while honest agents compound trust and earn.
